protocol:
BMDM Salmonella Replication
The day before.
Inoculate 5 ml of TSB with 1 colony of Salmonella Typhimurium.
Incubate on the wheel at 37C overnight.
Collect BMDM using a cell scraper.
Transfer the cells from one Petri dish to a 50-ml tube.
Centrifuge 10 min at 1200 RPM.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Re-suspend the cells using 3-ml syringe and needle (start with a 21 or 20 gauge needle and finish with 25 gauge in 2 ml RPMI + 10% FCS.
Count BMDM using the Coulter Counter or a 1/5 dilution with Turks.
(1.5ml Acetic acid, 48.5 ddH2O and Gentacin Violet – trace).
Adjust with fresh cell culture medium the number of cells to a final concentration of 1x10^6 cells per ml.
Aliquot 500 μL (5x10^5 cells) per well for a 24-well plate.
Aliquot 3 mL (3x10^6 cells) per well for a 6-well plate.
And 100ul for 96 well plate.
Incubate o/n at 37C, 5% CO2.
For LDH, all the samples are in triplicate.
The day of the experiment:Inoculate 50 ml of TSB with 2 ml of the overnight culture of Salmonella.
Grow at 37C with agitation until the OD at 600nm reaches 0.9 (it takes between 90-120 min).
Place the bacterial culture on ice and adjust the OD to 0.9 if needed.
In the meantime, prepare all the media which need to be kept at 37CMedium in which to add bacteriaPBS for the washesGentamicin +RPMI+10%FCSTitron and PBS for lysis Centrifuge two tubes of 1 ml (5 x 10^8 bact) of the bacterial culture and resuspend in 1 ml of saline or PBS or RPMI without FCS.
Use Eppendorf tube and centrifuge in the cold room 3-4 min at 13000 RPM.
Verify that the BMDM are healthy under the microscope.
Remove the cell culture medium and replace it with RPMI and 10% FCSPer well:6-well plate: 3 ml RPMI +10%FCS and 60ul bacteria24-well plate: 500 μL RPMI +FCS and 10ul bacteria96 well plate: 100ul RPMI+10%FCS and 2ul bacteria(10 μL corresponds approximately to 5x10^6 bacteria; MOI of 10 bacteria/cell).
For a 6-well plate, prepare 20 ml of culture medium + 400 μl of washed bacteria.
For a 24-well plate, prepare 15 ml of culture medium + 300 μl of washed bacteria.
For a 96 well place, prepare 10ml of culture medium and 200ul of washed bacteria.
But for LDH, you only need to prepare enough for the Salmonella wells, not for all 96 wells.
Centrifuge at 500g for 5 minutes at 25C Incubate 45 min at 37C, 5% CO2.
During the incubation time, plate the infectious dose 10^-3 (100 μl), 10^-4 (100 μl) and 10^-5 (100 μl).
After the incubation period, remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells twice with PBS (preheated at 37C) (prepared before hand) using: 500 μl for 24-well plate and 10 ml for 6-well plate. 100ul for 96 well plate.
Add 500 μL (24-well plate) or 2 ml (6-well plate) RPMI 10% FCS without phenol for LDH (preheated at 37C) containing 100 μg/ml gentamicin.
Add an extra triplicate for medium.
For a 24-well plate, prepare 15 ml of culture medium + 150 μl of gentamicin 10 mg/ml.
For a 6-well plate, prepare 20 ml of culture medium + 200 μl of of gentamicin 10 mg/ml.
For a 96 well plate, prepare 15ml of culture medium + 150ul of gentamicin at 10mg/ml.
This corresponds to time 0 for LDH.
Start timer for time points and 45 min prior to last time point for max rel.
For all time points: spin plate at 250g for 4min *keep on ice*. 
Take 50ul of supernatant for LDH into special LDH plates (can use multichanel) and keep on ice.
Take 50ul for ELISA cytokine expression.
Lyse cells with 100ul of PBS-1% Titron X-100 (prepared in advance).
Tranfer 100ul to 2ml push cap tubes for plating.
Dilute 50ul in 450ul for 10^-1 and 10^-2#CFUs/50μl x 100 for LDH x dilution = CFUs per well.
Continue on for Non LDH experiment: Incubate 1 hour at 37C, 5% CO2. 
After the incubation period, remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells twice with PBS (preheated at 37C) using 500 μl for 24-well plate ml for 6-well plate.
Add 500 μL (24-well plate) or 2 ml (6-well plate) RPMI 10% FCS (preheated at 37C) containing 10 μg/ml gentamicin.
For a 24-well plate, prepare 15 ml of culture medium + 15 μl of gentamicin10 mg/ml.
For a 6-well plate, prepare 20 ml of culture medium + 20 μl of of gentamicin 10 mg/ml.
Pursue the incubation (1, 2, and 4 h).
Time 0 corresponds to the time just after adding the RPMI containing 10μg/ml gentamicin.
At each time point, collect the supernatants for future cytokine ELISA assays and freeze them at -80C.
Lyse the cells with 500 μL PBS- 1%Triton X-100 and transfer the lysate to 4-ml push cap tube.
Dilute the lysate (10-1 to 10-3).
Spread 100 μL of 10-2 and 10-3 dilutions on TSB Petri dishes and incubate overnight.
The day after: Count the CFUs taking into account the volume plated and the dilution.
#CFUs/100μl x 500 x dilution = CFUs per well

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: inoculate (container: 5 ml tube or flask, reagent: TSB + 1 colony Salmonella Typhimurium, volume: 5 ml TSB, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='tube or flask', reagent='Salmonella Typhimurium in TSB', volume='5 ml', temperature='37C', duration='overnight', speed='wheel')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: collect (container: Petri dish, reagent: BMDM, other: {'method': 'cell scraper'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
transfer(container='50-ml tube', reagent='BMDM cells', from='Petri dish')
centrifuge(container='50-ml tube', reagent='BMDM cells', duration='10 min', speed='1200 RPM')
remove(container='50-ml tube', reagent='supernatant', discard=True)

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: resuspend (container: 50-ml tube, reagent: BMDM cells in RPMI + 10% FCS, volume: 2 ml, other: {'method': '3-ml syringe and needle (21/20 gauge start, 25 gauge finish)'})
# MANUAL: count (reagent: BMDM, other: {'method': 'Coulter Counter or 1/5 dilution with Turks'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
adjust(reagent='BMDM cells', final concentration='1x10^6 cells/ml', medium='fresh cell culture medium')
aliquot(container='24-well plate', reagent='BMDM cell suspension', volume='500 μL (5x10^5 cells)')
aliquot(container='6-well plate', reagent='BMDM cell suspension', volume='3 ml (3x10^6 cells)')
aliquot(container='96-well plate', reagent='BMDM cell suspension', volume='100 μL')
incubate(container='plates (24-well, 6-well, 96-well)', reagent='BMDM cells', temperature='37C', duration='overnight', CO2='5%')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: inoculate (container: 50 ml tube or flask, reagent: TSB + 2 ml overnight Salmonella culture, volume: 50 ml TSB + 2 ml culture, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='tube or flask', reagent='Salmonella in TSB', volume='50 ml', temperature='37C', duration='90-120 min (until OD600=0.9)', speed='agitation')
place(container='tube or flask', reagent='bacterial culture', temperature='on ice')
adjust(container='tube or flask', reagent='bacterial culture', OD600='0.9')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: prepare (reagent: media (RPMI+10%FCS, PBS, Gentamicin, Titron), temperature: 37C (for media to be kept warm), other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
centrifuge(container='Eppendorf tube', reagent='1 ml bacterial culture (5x10^8 bacteria)', volume='1 ml', temperature='cold room', duration='3-4 min', speed='13000 RPM')
resuspend(container='Eppendorf tube', reagent='bacterial pellet in saline or PBS or RPMI without FCS', volume='1 ml')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: verify (container: Petri dish/plate, reagent: BMDM, other: {'method': 'microscope'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
remove(container='well plate', reagent='cell culture medium', replace_with='RPMI + 10% FCS')
add(container='6-well plate', reagent='RPMI + 10% FCS and bacteria', volume='3 ml RPMI + 60 μl bacteria')
add(container='24-well plate', reagent='RPMI + 10% FCS and bacteria', volume='500 μL RPMI + 10 μl bacteria')
add(container='96-well plate', reagent='RPMI + 10% FCS and bacteria', volume='100 μL RPMI + 2 μl bacteria')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 6-well plate, reagent: culture medium + washed bacteria, volume: 20 ml medium + 400 μl bacteria, other: {})
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 24-well plate, reagent: culture medium + washed bacteria, volume: 15 ml medium + 300 μl bacteria, other: {})
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 96-well plate, reagent: culture medium + washed bacteria, volume: 10 ml medium + 200 μl bacteria, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
centrifuge(container='well plate', reagent='cells', temperature='25C', duration='5 min', speed='500g')
incubate(container='well plate', reagent='cells', temperature='37C', duration='45 min', CO2='5%')
plate(container='Petri dish', reagent='infectious dose dilutions', volume='100 μl each (10^-3, 10^-4, 10^-5)')
remove(container='well plate', reagent='supernatant', discard=True)
wash(container='well plate', reagent='PBS (preheated at 37C)', volume='500 μl for 24-well, 10 ml for 6-well, 100 μl for 96-well', temperature='37C', times=2)
add(container='24-well plate', reagent='RPMI 10% FCS (preheated at 37C) + 100 μg/ml gentamicin', volume='500 μL', temperature='37C', for='LDH')
add(container='6-well plate', reagent='RPMI 10% FCS (preheated at 37C) + 100 μg/ml gentamicin', volume='2 ml', temperature='37C', for='LDH')
add(container='96-well plate', reagent='RPMI 10% FCS (preheated at 37C) + 100 μg/ml gentamicin', volume='100 μl', temperature='37C', for='LDH')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 24-well plate, reagent: culture medium + gentamicin 10 mg/ml, volume: 15 ml medium + 150 μl gentamicin, other: {})
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 6-well plate, reagent: culture medium + gentamicin 10 mg/ml, volume: 20 ml medium + 200 μl gentamicin, other: {})
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 96-well plate, reagent: culture medium + gentamicin 10 mg/ml, volume: 15 ml medium + 150 μl gentamicin, other: {})
# MANUAL: start (other: {'timer': 'for time points and 45 min prior to last time point for max rel'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
centrifuge(container='well plate', reagent='cells', temperature='on ice', duration='4 min', speed='250g')
take(container='well plate', reagent='supernatant for LDH', volume='50 μl', temperature='on ice', destination='special LDH plates')
take(container='well plate', reagent='supernatant for ELISA', volume='50 μl', destination='ELISA plates')
lyse(container='well plate', reagent='PBS-1% Triton X-100', volume='100 μl', prepared_in_advance=True)
transfer(container='2 ml push cap tube', reagent='lysate', volume='100 μl')
dilute(reagent='lysate', volume='50 μl in 450 μl for 10^-1 and 10^-2')
incubate(container='well plate', reagent='cells', temperature='37C', duration='1 hour', CO2='5%')
remove(container='well plate', reagent='supernatant', discard=True)
wash(container='well plate', reagent='PBS (preheated at 37C)', volume='500 μl for 24-well, ml for 6-well', temperature='37C', times=2)
add(container='24-well plate', reagent='RPMI 10% FCS (preheated at 37C) + 10 μg/ml gentamicin', volume='500 μl', temperature='37C')
add(container='6-well plate', reagent='RPMI 10% FCS (preheated at 37C) + 10 μg/ml gentamicin', volume='2 ml', temperature='37C')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 24-well plate, reagent: culture medium + gentamicin 10 mg/ml, volume: 15 ml medium + 15 μl gentamicin, other: {})
# MANUAL: prepare (container: 6-well plate, reagent: culture medium + gentamicin 10 mg/ml, volume: 20 ml medium + 20 μl gentamicin, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='well plate', reagent='cells', temperature='37C', duration='1, 2, and 4 h', CO2='5%')
collect(container='well plate', reagent='supernatant', for='cytokine ELISA')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: freeze (container: tube, reagent: supernatant, temperature: -80C, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
lyse(container='well plate', reagent='PBS-1% Triton X-100', volume='500 μl')
transfer(container='4-ml push cap tube', reagent='lysate')
dilute(reagent='lysate', dilutions='10^-1 to 10^-3')
spread(container='TSB Petri dish', reagent='10^-2 and 10^-3 lysate dilutions', volume='100 μl each')
incubate(container='TSB Petri dish', reagent='spread lysate dilutions', temperature='overnight')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: count (container: TSB Petri dish, reagent: CFUs, other: {'consider': 'volume plated and dilution'})
